references.text: The king of Jarmuth is mentioned among the five Amorite kings who allied against Gibeon and were defeated by Joshua
The king of Jarmuth was brought out of the cave at Makkedah along with the other kings after their defeat
Lachish was captured by Joshua and the Israelites, and the entire city was struck down with the sword
Jarmuth is listed as one of the cities in Judah's inheritance in the lowland
Lachish is mentioned as one of the cities in Judah's inheritance
